title: Revenue Operations Analyst
location: Framingham, MA - hybrid (2 days/week in office)
why_fit: Entry-level (0-2 yrs) analyst role built on SQL, dashboards, forecasting and pricing, which maps to his AMG budgeting, KPI reporting and Python automation.
why_us: Definitive sells data to healthcare leaders, and the Revenue Operations Analyst role turns commercial data into forecasts, pricing views and dashboards that leaders act on. That is close to what I do at AMG Family Dental, where I build the annual budget and monthly forecasts, run budget-vs-actual variance analysis and produce KPI reports for ownership. I also automated our weekly insurance reconciliation in Python, cutting it from 5 hours to 1. I like that this role sits between sales, finance and customer success, and that it is entry-level with real SQL work from day one.
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Revenue Operations Analyst role at Definitive Healthcare. The posting asks for someone who can turn commercial data into reporting that sales, finance and customer success leaders use, and that is the work I have been doing for the past three years, just on a smaller scale.

At AMG Family Dental in Belmont, I run financial operations for a practice serving 1,000+ patients a year. I build the annual operating budget and monthly forecasts, track budget against actual, and send ownership KPI reports. I also review pricing and revenue tracking. By improving our financial reporting and reconciliation process in Dentrix, I identified and recovered more than $500K in annual revenue that had been slipping through. I then wrote a Python script that automates our weekly insurance payment reconciliation, which cut processing time from 5 hours to 1 and flags underpaid claims for follow-up.

The forecasting, pricing and revenue optimization part of your posting interests me most. At Northrop Grumman I analyzed material pricing, supplier costs and budget variances across several programs and presented cost-saving recommendations to senior leadership, so I am used to explaining numbers to people who have to make a decision from them. My M.A. in International Economics & Finance from Brandeis and my B.S. in Finance from Suffolk gave me the econometrics, statistics and corporate finance foundation, and I work in SQL, Python (Pandas, NumPy), Excel and Tableau.

I understand this is an entry-level position, and I would rather grow into the dashboard and data-model side of the job than pretend I already have it all. I am a US citizen, fluent in English and Armenian, and available immediately. The Framingham hybrid schedule works for me.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
